title: epoch_to_rfc2822 calendar algorithm duplicated in two test modules
description: Identical 30-line Rata Die calendar algorithm (epoch_to_rfc2822 / now_rfc2822) exists in validate_headers.rs tests and lifecycle.rs tests. A bug fix to the non-trivial calendar math must be applied twice. Maintenance consequence: calendar bugs will silently reappear in one location after being fixed in the other.
